name: Sun Blade

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Widen or narrow the light
powers.text: Bonus Action: the blade's light grows or shrinks by 5 ft at a time (bright 10 to 30 ft, the same again dim).

summary: A blade of sunlight: +2, Radiant, Finesse; an extra 1d8 Radiant against Undead; it sheds sunlight.
text: It looks like nothing more than a longsword hilt. Gripping it, you can use a Bonus Action to call forth a blade of pure radiance, or to dismiss it. With the blade out it is a magic longsword with the Finesse property, and longsword proficiency covers it. It grants +2 to attack and damage rolls and deals Radiant damage in place of Slashing, and Undead it hits suffer 1d8 extra Radiant damage. The blade gives off sunlight: Bright Light out to 15 feet and Dim Light 15 feet past that. While the blade is out, a Bonus Action widens or narrows the lit area by 5 feet for both Bright and Dim Light, with each kept between 10 and 30 feet.
